g.text: Title: Audio - PWM filter and mono amplifier

g.desc: Title: Audio - PWM filter and mono amplifier

g.text: Draft: component choices, GPIO and power budget TBD.

g.desc: Draft: component choices, GPIO and power budget TBD.

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: One AUDIO_PWM GPIO, 3.3 V. Proposed >= 62.5 kHz carrier; vary duty for ~0.5-2 kHz game tones.

g.desc: One AUDIO_PWM GPIO, 3.3 V. Proposed >= 62.5 kHz carrier; vary duty for ~0.5-2 kHz game tones.

g.text: R60/R61 attenuate to at most ~0.30 Vpp before loading. Two RC poles suppress the carrier; values are provisional.

g.desc: R60/R61 attenuate to at most ~0.30 Vpp before loading. Two RC poles suppress the carrier; values are provisional.

g.text: Silence: steady PWM duty (50% proposed). Check residual carrier, clipping and startup pop on the real board.

g.desc: Silence: steady PWM duty (50% proposed). Check residual carrier, clipping and startup pop on the real board.

g.text: Manual mute uses no extra MCU pin; automatic shutdown would need another allocated output.

g.desc: Manual mute uses no extra MCU pin; automatic shutdown would need another allocated output.

g.text: Tie A- to ground for this single-ended input.

g.desc: Tie A- to ground for this single-ended input.

g.text: Use onboard trim to set volume; start low.

g.desc: Use onboard trim to set volume; start low.

g.text: NEITHER speaker lead goes to GND.

g.desc: NEITHER speaker lead goes to GND.

g.text: AU1 PROPOSAL - Adafruit PAM8302 board + 4 ohm / 3 W speaker; not confirmed owned.

g.desc: AU1 PROPOSAL - Adafruit PAM8302 board + 4 ohm / 3 W speaker; not confirmed owned.

g.text: Use shared 5 V / 3 A load rail, not the ~100 mA PIC supply. Include audio peaks in total load budget.

g.desc: Use shared 5 V / 3 A load rail, not the ~100 mA PIC supply. Include audio peaks in total load budget.

g.text: C62/C63 near module; short supply/return and twisted speaker pair. Board has additional onboard bypassing.

g.desc: C62/C63 near module; short supply/return and twisted speaker pair. Board has additional onboard bypassing.

g.text: U30/LS30 are assembly symbols with logical port labels, not bare-chip or physical header pin numbers.

g.desc: U30/LS30 are assembly symbols with logical port labels, not bare-chip or physical header pin numbers.

g.text: See audio.md for sources and remaining component/volume decisions.

g.desc: See audio.md for sources and remaining component/volume decisions.
